Container.Name: carlauncher-config
Container.Overview: Config server for Car Launcher. A web editor for making dashboard layouts and colour themes, which the launcher on your car tablet or head unit downloads. In the launcher, go to Settings, then Config server, and enter http://[your Unraid IP]:8080.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the editor and for the launcher to sync from.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Where layouts and themes are saved, one JSON file each.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the server runs as (Unraid: 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the server runs as (Unraid: 100 = users).

Config.Name: Admin token
Config.Description: Optional password for saving changes in the editor. Leave empty for none. The launcher never needs it.
